# Brand asset sources

Original SVG files; colors and geometry are unchanged. Used to identify example tools.

- Supabase: https://supabase.com/brand-assets — `https://supabase.com/brand-assets.zip`, `supabase-logo-icon.svg`.
- Stripe: https://stripe.com/newsroom/information — official Stripe logo kit, `Stripe wordmark - Blurple.svg`.
- Slack: https://slack.com/media-kit — `https://a.slack-edge.com/9cc0056/marketing/img/nav/logo.svg`.
- Shopify: https://www.shopify.com/brand-assets — Shopping Bag full-color SVG.

The kitchen photograph was generated for Stitchr.
